Four ways to read a query. One cache.

Pick the shape that suits the screen. All four take the same options and behave the same.
Extension
final task = context.query(taskQuery(id));
Builder
QueryBuilder(options: taskQuery(id), builder: …)
State mixin
with QueryMixin … watchQuery(taskQuery(id))
Controller
QueryController.create(client, taskQuery(id))
